name: Social Media
prompt_section:
### Social Media Tools
- openInstagramProfile(username) — open Instagram profile
- openTelegramChat(username) — open Telegram chat
- openYouTubeVideo(videoId) — open YouTube video by ID
- playSpotify(query) — search and play on Spotify
- searchInApp(package, query) — search in YouTube/Spotify/Instagram/Chrome
